record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: CUTIEFLY and RIBOMBEE declare ability POLLEN_PUFF (passive NONE in the catalog). The strategy is shared; differences are stars and stats. Other units are not covered.
record.summary: Single-ally heal; the ability needs no enemy target (requiresTarget = false). It picks, among all entities on the board of the caster's team (the caster included, full-HP allies included), the one with the lowest ABSOLUTE current hp (a.hp - b.hp; not the lowest percentage and not the largest missing HP; a tie keeps the first in the cells array), and requests a heal of 30 (CUTIEFLY, 1 star) or 60 (RIBOMBEE, 2 stars) raw on it, with apBoost 1 and the cast crit flag, so the request scales with the CASTER's AP and critPower. The recipient then passes handleHeal: a wounded recipient gets no HP heal (with BLOODMOON weather and a Blood Stone owned by its player the wound branch first requests addShield(round(0.3 x stones x the raw requested heal)) with the recipient as the shield's caster, so the apBoost / crit passed along use the recipient's AP and crit power; Protect does not stop it), an unwounded recipient with status.protect gets nothing (Rune Protect alone does not block), burn and enraged halve it, BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED x1.3 and ZENITH x1.2 raise it, the result is rounded and capped at the missing HP (on a GRASS-synergy recipient the overheal, i.e. the rounded modified heal minus the missing HP, requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal) - 0.4 times the overheal amount, not 40% of the recipient's existing max HP; the request also raises current HP and goes through Big Eater Belt / Twist Band). No damage, no status, no movement. If no ally is found nothing happens, but PP is still spent in super.process. Requested amount: 30/60 raw; applied: after AP, crit, item/status modifiers and the missing-HP cap.

targeting.who: the allied entity (own team, caster included) with the lowest current hp; the cast target passed to the strategy is null and unused
targeting.note: requiresTarget is overridden to false; how the cast is triggered without a target (range and targeting gates in the attacking state) was not traced.

geometry.shape: no geometry: board-wide selection of one ally, independent of range or position

effects.scaling: requested = raw table amount; handleHeal multiplies by (1 + AP/100) with the CASTER's ap (apBoost 1) and by the caster's critPower when the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false), then x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH weather on the recipient/weather
effects.resolution: Applied heal = round(modified request) capped at the recipient's missing HP; the excess is overheal; on a GRASS-synergy recipient it requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal, recipient, 0, false, false), i.e. 0.4 times the overheal as max HP (not 40% of the existing max HP); addMaxHP rounds, applies Big Eater Belt / Twist Band, raises maxHP and the current HP by the final value, and nothing is added to healDone (probe: recipient 990/1000, heal 50 -> healed 10, overheal 40, request 16, final maxHP and HP 1016). A wounded recipient receives 0 HP heal, but with BLOODMOON weather and a Blood Stone owned by its player the wound branch first requests addShield(round(0.3 x stones x raw heal), recipient, apBoost 1, crit): the raw 30 / 60 with one stone gives a base request of 9 / 18, then the recipient's own AP and crit power scale it (the recipient is passed as the shield's caster) and Big Eater Belt / the enraged halving apply in addShield (probe, apBoost 0: heal 20 -> request 6, final 7 with Big Eater Belt). That wound branch is before the Protect test, so Protect does not stop it. An unwounded recipient with status.protect receives nothing (no HP, no overheal); status.runeProtect is not read. Because the recipient is chosen by lowest absolute hp, it may be a full-HP ally (caster included), in which case the whole amount is overheal. The target selection reads hp at cast time, no randomness.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; 3 (120) and 4 (240, also the fallback) are not reachable by the two units' bare star counts (1, 2). maxPP 40 and range 2 for both.

record.positionalConditions: None: the recipient is chosen board-wide by current hp, ignoring distance. Dead or removed entities are assumed absent from board.cells (not traced).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state and no modes. Each cast re-selects the lowest-hp ally and heals it again.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw heal 30/60 (Cutiefly/Ribombee). Heal received = round(raw x (1 + AP/100) [x critPower] x item/status/weather factors) capped at the recipient's missing HP; 0 HP if wounded or (unwounded) protected (status.protect). Overheal requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal) on a Grass recipient; a wounded recipient with a Blood Stone under Blood Moon gets an addShield request instead. The recipient is the lowest absolute hp ally, which may already be at full hp.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight, and how a requiresTarget = false cast is triggered (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the heal-side multipliers were read
Heal modifiers beyond the wound, Blood Stone shield, protect guard, AP, crit, burn, enraged, weather and Grass overheal steps listed (other items or synergy hooks on heal)
unresolved: Whether board.cells can contain entities that should not be eligible (dead, summoned or non-targetable allies, e.g. an INANIMATE or hidden unit): the filter cell.team === pokemon.team was read as written; no alive/targetable check appears in the strategy
Tie-breaking and ordering of board.cells (array order) was not traced beyond the stable sort in the strategy
Passive none for both units; no other unit sharing the identifier exists in the queue
Source reading only; no probe or fight was run

Probe SHARED_HELPERS (pinned handleHeal / addMaxHP / addShield text, stub units, apBoost 0, no crit): Grass recipient 990/1000, heal 50 -> healed 10, overheal 40, addMaxHP request 16 (final 1016, or 1020 with Big Eater Belt); wound + Protect + Blood Moon + one Blood Stone, heal 20 -> no HP, addShield request 6; Protect -> 0 healed; Rune Protect alone -> healed. The POLLEN_PUFF apBoost 1 and crit scaling of those requests uses the recipient's AP / crit power by source reading only (the probe passes apBoost 0).
